steps.title: Dismiss notice and return to the opener

functionalJourney.title: Restore focus after closing a real dialog

plan.root_cause: In the hide method, the focus is restored to the previously focused element before removing the focus trap listener. When focus moves to the opener, the listener still active moves focus back to the dialog, preventing focus return.
plan.repair_strategy: Reorder the hide method to first remove the focus and keydown listeners, then restore focus to the previously focused element.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Focus returns to the opener button after closing the dialog via Escape or close button, satisfying focus order requirements.
functional_risks: If any external code relies on the focus trap listener being active during the focus restoration step, it may not receive expected events.
Removing listeners before focus restoration could theoretically miss a key event that occurs exactly at the same time, but this is unlikely as the dialog is being hidden.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape when the dialog is open moves focus back to the opener button.
Verify that clicking the close button also moves focus back to the opener.
Verify that while the dialog is open, Tab key traps focus inside the dialog and Escape still closes it.
Verify that the dialog's open and close events still fire as expected.
